# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-10-31):
> stock Strata v0.2.8 (engine 0.1.54) + stock OMP 18.14.0 across all three hosts and the Mac Studio route: on the
> RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock
> roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24
> `--layer-split 24`, stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights` (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`) growing each
> card's expert cache by 1.8 GiB to 19.15 GiB on the RTX 3090 and 17.76 GiB on the RTX 4090 vs 17.35 and 16.01 GiB on
> its `roles-pledirect` rollback and cutting 32K-100K time to first token (TTFT) 12% and G17's near-limit task wall from
> 67.0 s to 60.8 s, pipeline windows 2, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090, and `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning
> stock `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the
> engine's 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache and 27.8 GiB Windows commit headroom of a 135.7 GiB limit;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to the 2026-10-30 v0.2.8 `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with four batch slots, per-slot multi-token prediction (MTP)
> `--batch-mtp` (`strata.batch_mtp: true`: +22.5% total output at two concurrent requests, +8% at four 2K requests and
> +40% summed decode at four 40K prompts, neutral for one request), direct PLE reads `--ple-io direct`
> (`strata.ple_io: "direct"`: 35.5-51.5 s restart readiness, G16 51.4 s, G20 51.5 s, G15 kill recall 49.9-50.6 s, and
> 81.3 GiB G10 Windows commit headroom of 219.7 GiB), the engine's 8,192 MiB conversation parking and 32K chunks
> (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json)),
> with `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0` as the PRO's qualified alternative
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json);
> PLE direct reads without `--batch-mtp`, G20 restart readiness 35.0 s, G16 51.4 s, 82.8-82.9 GiB commit headroom) and
> the 2026-10-30 v0.2.8 `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0` as the PRO's rollback (whose
> integration root stays installed),
> and on an RTX 5090 (`rtx5090-win-a`), where the owner made the 262,144-token Coder IQ1_M profile the host's default
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json)),
> with an unchanged 36 GiB available-RAM start floor and a 3,584 MiB automatic conversation cache (31 parks in G19; G10
> serving: 11.17 GiB available RAM, 18.05 GiB commit headroom of an 85.15 GiB limit; G16 restart ready in 28.3 s, lowest
> available RAM 9.79 GiB). Operating condition for the RTX 5090 262K default: the host's Docker Desktop and WSL, which
> run its production NInfer container, must be stopped; after WSL restarts, that container must be recreated by the
> owner's pinned relaunch script and re-registered with the owner's fleet controller. The 131,072-token Coder IQ1_M
> profile (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json))
> is the qualified alternative for running with Docker Desktop and WSL up (the production container stopped by the fleet
> controller; 34 GiB start floor). Both RTX 5090 ledgers have 21 pass and 3 not applicable, retaining the main-chain G10
> listener-check failures on Windows build 26300.9818 beside the passing G10 reruns at `f9e8c74`.
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts

> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`,
  runs stock OMP 18.14.0 through an SSH local forward to
  `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`, the PRO's current v0.2.8 262K
  batch-MTP + PLE-direct profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-10-31 at `610be03`: missing key refused before
  launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 5.1-8.8 ms and stream TTFT 0.278 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the
  prior transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen (0.88 s), client restart (0.66 s) and verified
  server restart (1.62 s), and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK`. Its qualified rollback,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`, reaches the PRO's v0.2.8 262K `slots4-parking` rollback (G23 pass on
  2026-10-30 at `4853ab3`). The 0.2.7, 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1, 0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and
  `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): lifecycle, recovery, logs, upgrades, requalifying a new tuple
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects
- [Measurements](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): resources, throughput, context, restart cost, evaluation results
- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
